title: Da Buddha Aroma Top
description:
Elevate your aromatherapy with the Da Buddha Aroma Top, expertly designed to enhance your Da Buddha Vaporizer experience. This robust, high-quality DBV glass aroma top is meticulously crafted to fit seamlessly on your DBV, ensuring effortless setup. Just place the DBV Aroma Dish atop your vaporizer, add your choice of oils, or a combination of oils and wax, to unlock a symphony of scents.

Alternatively, introduce a tea light candle to prolong the fragrance release from 2 to over 8 hours, maximizing your enjoyment. Ideal for those who cherish a long-lasting, aromatic environment, the Da Buddha Aroma Top transforms your space with superior efficiency and style. Perfect for users of the Da Buddha dry herb vape, this accessory is a must-have for enhancing your vaping and aromatic experience.
